{{note|87|87.|bold=no|italics=no}}For general information on Hage, see Oriana Gill, “Hunting Bin Laden: A Portrait of Wadih El Hage, Accused Terrorist,” PBS ''Frontline'' broadcast, Sept. 12, 2001. On returning to the United States, Hage was met at the airport by FBI agents, interrogated, and called the next day before the federal grand jury then investigating Bin Ladin. Because he lied to the grand jury about his association with Bin Ladin and al Qaeda, he was ar rested immediately after the embassy bombings a year later. Testimony of Patrick Fitzgerald before the Senate Judiciary Committee, Oct. 21, 2003, pp. 3–4.
